newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian Serb, federation leaders discuss ties.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Serb, federation leaders discuss ties.

text.p: A senior Bosnian Croat official said on Tuesday Croatia was ready to step up politicial and economic cooperation with the Bosnian Serbs.
Croatia was ready to open a bridge and border crossing, a consulate and a trade mission in Banja Luka, Kresimir Zubak said in the northern Serb town of Banja Luka.
He was speaking to reporters after meeting Bosnian Serb President Biljana Plavsic.
The two also discussed exchanges of prisoners of war and bodies of soldiers killed in action and economic cooperation.
They also reached an agreement to release all prisoners of war, Bosnian Serb news agency SRNA reported.

Zubak, a Croat who is also the president of the Bosnian Moslem-Croat Federation which together with the Bosnian Serb republic comprises post-war Bosnia, arrived in Banja Luka earlier in the day at the invitation of the remaining 7,500 Croats living in the region.
Banja Luka, the biggest Bosnian Serb industrial city, is traditionally dependent on trade with neighbouring Croatia.
